title: Electrician website UX + SEO + social proof + performance improvements (single-page scroll)

requirements.summary: Restrict primary navigation (desktop/mobile) and footer quick links to Home, Services, About Us, Contact with smooth scrolling to sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Header desktop navigation shows exactly 4 items: Home, Services, About Us, Contact.
Header mobile menu shows the same 4 items and closes after selection.
Footer "Quick Links" shows the same 4 items.
Each nav item scrolls to a visible section heading (not hidden under the fixed header).

file_operations.description: Update navItems to include exactly: Home (home), Services (services), About Us (about), Contact (contact). Ensure mobile selection closes the menu and uses the existing smooth scrolling helper. Use shadcn-ui Button for any header CTAs that remain; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Update "Quick Links" to include exactly: Home, Services, About Us, Contact, using the existing scrollToSection behavior. Verify any shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm scroll padding/margins keep section headings visible below the fixed header; adjust scroll-padding-top/scroll-margin-top only if needed to satisfy the offset requirement without layout regressions.

requirements.summary: Present the 5 required services as distinct, clearly separated entries with title, short description, icon, professional image, and a contact/booking CTA.
acceptanceCriteria: The Services area prominently includes the 5 listed services as distinct items (not buried among many unrelated categories).
Each of the 5 services displays: title, description, icon, and image.
Each service item includes a visible call-to-action (CTA) that leads the visitor to contact/booking (e.g., scroll to Contact or open a call link).
All service images include descriptive alt text in English.

file_operations.description: Add a prominent "Core Services" block at the top of the Services section containing exactly these 5 service cards: Home Wiring, Emergency Repairs, Fuse/Panel Upgrades, Light Fitting/LED Work, Appliance Installation. Each card must include: (1) title, (2) short description, (3) icon (lucide-react), (4) image using the required generated assets, (5) a visible CTA that scrolls to Contact and/or provides tel: call. Use shadcn-ui Card and Button components for consistent layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure there is a clear contact target within the Contact section for service CTAs (keep id="contact"), and optionally add a small helper note near the form header confirming users can request quotes/bookings for the listed services. Verify shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add prominent CTAs (“Get a Free Quote”, “Book Now”, “Call Us”) across Hero, Services, About Us, and Contact; ensure Call uses tel:9953854470.
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section contains clearly visible CTAs including “Get a Free Quote”, “Book Now”, and “Call Us”.
Services section provides at least one visible CTA per service (or per service card) that enables booking/quote/call.
“Call Us” opens the dialer using a tel: link and uses the existing number (9953854470).
CTAs are usable on mobile without overlapping the fixed header.

file_operations.description: Revise the primary hero button group to include the exact CTA labels: “Get a Free Quote” (scroll to Contact), “Book Now” (WhatsApp using existing helper), and “Call Us” (tel:9953854470 via an anchor). Use shadcn-ui Button (including asChild for the tel: link) for consistent styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure each of the 5 highlighted service cards includes a visible CTA option that supports booking/quote/call (at minimum one CTA per card). Use shadcn-ui Button for CTAs; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a compact CTA row in About Us that includes “Get a Free Quote”, “Book Now”, and “Call Us” (tel:9953854470), without changing existing contact details. Use shadcn-ui Button for consistent presentation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add visible CTAs near the Contact section heading (e.g., “Call Us” tel:9953854470 and “Book Now” WhatsApp) while keeping the existing email/phone unchanged. Use shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement a floating, always-available contact CTA with Call and WhatsApp that doesn’t block key content or form fields.
acceptanceCriteria: A floating CTA is visible on scroll (especially on mobile).
Floating CTA includes a Call action (tel:9953854470) and a WhatsApp action (using the existing WhatsApp URL helper).
Floating CTA does not cover the Contact form submit button or inputs on common screen sizes.

file_operations.description: Implement this component as a floating contact CTA for both desktop and mobile with at least two actions: Call (tel:9953854470) and WhatsApp (use existing getWhatsAppChatURL helper). Use shadcn-ui Button for the floating actions; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Render the floating CTA component globally so it is always available across the single-page flow (ensure it appears above main content but below any critical modals/toasts). Verify shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Add/adjust safe-area-aware spacing and responsive positioning utilities/classes so the floating CTA does not overlap the Contact form submit button or inputs on typical mobile breakpoints (use existing .floating-safe-area patterns where possible).

requirements.summary: Add a responsive customer reviews/testimonials section with names and star ratings in the single-page flow (static content).
acceptanceCriteria: A new section for testimonials is visible on the page with a clear heading (in English).
At least 3 testimonials are shown with star ratings and short review text.
The section is responsive and readable on mobile.
No third-party review API integration is required (static testimonials are acceptable).

file_operations.description: Create a Testimonials section component (static content) that displays at least 3 testimonials with: name, star rating (visual stars), and short review text. Use shadcn-ui Card for testimonial layout and keep styling consistent with the existing theme; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire the Testimonials section into the single-page flow in a sensible position (e.g., after Services and before Contact) so it is visible during scrolling. Verify shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply basic on-page SEO: keyword-focused page title + meta description, and meaningful alt text for key images.
acceptanceCriteria: The HTML page title is updated to a clean, keyword-focused English title (no extra/duplicate words).
A meta description tag is present and includes relevant electrician service keywords in English.
All service images and major hero imagery have non-empty, descriptive English alt attributes.
No broken meta tags are introduced (valid HTML head).

file_operations.description: Update the <title> to a clean, keyword-focused English title (example-guided) and add a meta description tag with relevant electrician keywords in English (ensure valid HTML head markup).
Ensure hero imagery has a meaningful English alt attribute and is consistent with the updated positioning/branding text.
Ensure each of the 5 highlighted service images includes descriptive English alt text (not empty, not just the title if it’s insufficient).
If adding the team photo (REQ-9), ensure it includes a descriptive English alt attribute appropriate for SEO/accessibility.

requirements.summary: Improve performance by optimizing image loading: lazy-load below-the-fold images and avoid heavy above-the-fold assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Below-the-fold images (e.g., Services/Products cards) use lazy-loading behavior.
No layout-breaking changes are introduced while images load.
The site remains responsive and smooth on mobile devices.

file_operations.description: Treat the hero background as above-the-fold: ensure it is not unnecessarily heavy at runtime and loads predictably (e.g., avoid lazy-loading the hero image; keep stable sizing to prevent layout shift).

Add lazy-loading behavior to service card images that are below the fold while keeping their aspect ratio container to prevent layout shift (e.g., keep the existing aspect-video wrapper and add loading behavior on images).
If a team image is added, ensure it uses stable sizing and lazy-loading if it is below-the-fold, without causing layout shifts.

requirements.summary: Ensure secure browsing (no mixed content): all external CTA links use https and no http:// references exist in the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: No frontend code references http:// resources.
All external actions (e.g., WhatsApp link) open secure URLs.
No browser mixed-content warnings occur in a standard HTTPS deployment.

file_operations.description: Confirm WhatsApp URL generation uses only secure https URLs and does not introduce any http links (keep using the existing wa.me pattern).
Audit CTA link openings (e.g., WhatsApp) to ensure they only open secure URLs and do not introduce any http:// references. Verify shadcn-ui component usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure floating WhatsApp action uses the existing secure WhatsApp URL helper (https) and Call uses tel: without any http:// references. Use shadcn-ui Button; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add required generated professional images under frontend/public/assets/generated and wire them into Hero/Services/About with consistent styling and English captions/alt text.
acceptanceCriteria: All newly generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by components via /assets/generated/... paths.
The Services section uses the new service-specific photos for the 5 highlighted services.
A team photo is displayed in an appropriate place (e.g., About section) with descriptive English alt text.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static asset file at the required path so it can be referenced by the About section.
Add the generated static asset file at the required path so it can be referenced by the Services section (Home Wiring).
Add the generated static asset file at the required path so it can be referenced by the Services section (Emergency Repairs).
Add the generated static asset file at the required path so it can be referenced by the Services section (Fuse/Panel Upgrades).
Add the generated static asset file at the required path so it can be referenced by the Services section (Light Fitting/LED Work).
Add the generated static asset file at the required path so it can be referenced by the Services section (Appliance Installation).

Wire the 5 required service-specific images into the highlighted service entries using these exact asset paths: frontend/public/assets/generated/service-home-wiring.dim_800x600.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/service-emergency-repairs.dim_800x600.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/service-fuse-panel-upgrades.dim_800x600.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/service-led-light-fitting.dim_800x600.jpg, frontend/public/assets/generated/service-appliance-installation.dim_800x600.jpg. Ensure consistent styling and descriptive English alt text. Use shadcn-ui Card for consistent visuals; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add the team photo to the About section using frontend/public/assets/generated/team-photo.dim_1200x800.jpg with a descriptive English alt attribute and styling consistent with existing sections. Use shadcn-ui Card where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Confirm the Hero section continues to use a professional image from frontend/public/assets/generated (existing hero background is acceptable) with consistent styling and descriptive English alt text.
